replication.target_description: Experiment 1 claim; final stage 2 within-participant ANOVA interaction of block type (progressive/stagnant) and response scale valence (positive/negative).

notes: Replication report identifies Experiment 1 and the block-by-scale-valence interaction, resolving otherwise empty locators. Final stage 2 selected; stage 1 results kept separate. Replication report internally says stage 1 had 346 participants and stage 2 added 139, while explicitly reporting final N=484 and F denominator df=483; final printed N retained. Original full text title and DOI verified through NCBI BioC. Original interaction effect-size expression is missing from the frozen BioC text parse (a blank after p=.01); effect size and metric therefore left null, without conversion or substitution of the positive-affect simple effect. Original locations use exact section/paragraph and BioC character offsets because the acquired primary full text has no page breaks.
